thread:
Sam: Dropping a fresh iteration of the Playground chat stream UI for review. Main asks: stream narration for screen readers, stop/regenerate labels, token breakdown placement, and how prompt library insertion behaves on desktop vs mobile. Figma: https://figma.redwood/proto/stream-ux-v2 (see notes).
Priya: Quick read 7: Love the inline microcopy. Two questions: 1) Should the stop control be a destructive color? 2) Token breakdown placement seems to cover the timestamp area on smaller widths.
Noor: For (1) I vote no on destructive red. Stopping a stream isn't destructive (we save partial). Use neutral outline with an icon and tooltip: "Stop". For (2) we can switch token pill to the left of the timestamp on widths < 520px.
Ethan: Regarding labels: we considered "Pause" earlier. Unless we implement resume/stream append, "Pause" is misleading. Keep "Stop" but add tooltip "Stop (keeps partial output)". Also add an explicit "Resume" CTA in the toast if we want re-run/regen equivalence? don't conflate.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: - stream container: aria-live="polite" and role="log" recommended to avoid repeated interrupts. - announce chunk boundaries with visually-hidden text "(continuing)" after first chunk. - ensure focusable controls have 48px touch target for mobile.
Priya: On token breakdown: instead of expanding on hover (not available on touch), show per-response tokens inline and add a chevron to open a small popover with session totals + est cost. That keeps mobile parity.
Noor: Motion UX: when streaming, animate a slim shimmer across the response area. If user stops, shimmer fades and we show a small badge "partial" next to the token pill. Also consider a persistent indicator for streaming in the convo list.
Sam: Dev note: keyboard bindings we'll ship: `Esc` => stop-stream, `Cmd+Enter` => send, `Ctrl+Enter` => regenerate. Add a short debounce on Esc (150ms) to avoid immediate accidental hits. Track events: playground_stream.start, playground_stream.stop_manual, playground_stream.stop_esc.
eng-bot: Added telemetry names to the tracking doc and created a feature flag `playground.stream_ui_v2`. Will gate on flag and do 10% canary.
a11y-bot: Additional: screen reader should not read token counts by default. Make token pill `aria-hidden=true` and expose details in the popover with an accessible label and role="dialog" when opened.
Ethan: Copy recs for toast after stop: "Stream stopped  Partial response saved. Click Regenerate to run again." Keep it short. Optionally include "Continue" which opens composer pre-filled  but do not claim it resumes.
Priya: Mobile: prompt library insertion should show a tiny preview chip in the composer and allow long-press to insert as template vs direct replace. Also add an undo snackbar after insertion.
Noor: Edge case: if user drags prompt while a stream is active, offer a small modal: "Replace response?" with options Replace, Append, Cancel. Append should be implemented as new message generation.
Sam: Action items for handoff: 1) Update figma with aria-live notes and popover behavior 2) Finalize copy for tooltips/toasts 3) Add Esc debounce 150ms in spec 4) Add token popover accessible content 5) Add telemetry events to tracking sheet.
Ethan: I'll take the front-end implementation. Will ping infra for canary rollout plan.
Priya: I'll update wording and the mobile interaction flows.
a11y-bot: I'll run a small checklist during review and flag any missing focus states.
Sam: Thanks all. If no objections I'll merge these changes into the dev handoff later today.
Priya: No objections from design.
Ethan: No engineering blockers.
Noor: A11y will sign off after one pass.
Sam: Closing thread — moving to handoff.
